description.sk: Kuracie stehná dusené v octe, sójovej omáčke, cesnaku a korení, na záver opečené dochrumkava.
description.en: Chicken thighs braised in vinegar, soy sauce, garlic and pepper, then crisped at the end.

steps.sk: Stehná daj do hrnca so sójovou omáčkou, octom, prelisovaným cesnakom, bobkovými listami, podrveným korením, cukrom a 200 ml vody. Nechaj ich v tom aspoň 20 minút marinovať, pokojne aj cez noc v chladničke.
steps.en: Put the thighs in a pot with the soy sauce, vinegar, crushed garlic, bay leaves, crushed pepper, sugar and 200 ml of water. Leave to marinate for at least 20 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.

steps.sk: Priveď do varu a prvé 2 minúty nemiešaj, aby ocot stratil ostrosť. Potom prikry a var na miernom ohni 30 minút, kým nie je mäso mäkké a pri kosti bez ružovej farby.
steps.en: Bring to the boil and do not stir for the first 2 minutes so the vinegar mellows. Then cover and simmer over a low heat for 30 minutes until the meat is tender and no longer pink at the bone.

steps.sk: Stehná vyber a osuš papierovou utierkou. Omáčku var bez pokrievky na vyššom ohni 8 až 10 minút, kým sa nezredukuje na polovicu a nezhustne.
steps.en: Lift out the thighs and pat them dry with kitchen paper. Boil the sauce uncovered over a higher heat for 8 to 10 minutes until reduced by half and thickened.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej a stehná opekaj kožou nadol 4 minúty, kým koža nie je chrumkavá a tmavozlatá. Vráť ich do omáčky a obaľ ich v nej.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the thighs skin side down for 4 minutes until the skin is crisp and deep golden. Return them to the sauce and turn to coat.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou, polej omáčkou a posyp nasekanou jarnou cibuľkou. Adobo vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a postátím chutí ešte lepšie.
steps.en: Serve with rice, spooning over the sauce, and sprinkle with chopped spring onion. Adobo keeps in the fridge for 4 days and tastes even better after a day.

title.sk: Gado-gado – indonézsky šalát s arašidovou omáčkou
title.en: Gado-gado: Indonesian salad with peanut sauce

description.sk: Zemiaky, chrumkavá zelenina, vajce a opečené tofu prelievané teplou arašidovou omáčkou.
description.en: Potatoes, crunchy vegetables, egg and fried tofu with a warm peanut sauce.

steps.sk: Zemiaky uvar v šupke 20 minút do mäkka, ošúp ich a nakrájaj na hrubé plátky. Vajcia uvar natvrdo 9 minút, ochlaď ich v studenej vode a prekroj na polovice.
steps.en: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20 minutes until tender, peel and cut into thick slices. Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool them in cold water and halve.

steps.sk: Do vriacej vody vhoď fazuľku nakrájanú na 4 cm a var 3 minúty, posledných 30 sekúnd pridaj kapustu nakrájanú na rezance a klíčky. Zeleninu sceď a hneď ju prepláchni studenou vodou, aby zostala chrumkavá a zelená.
steps.en: Drop the green beans, cut into 4 cm lengths, into boiling water and cook for 3 minutes, adding the shredded cabbage and bean sprouts for the last 30 seconds. Drain and rinse at once under cold water so they stay crisp and green.

steps.sk: Tofu osuš, nakrájaj na kocky 2 cm a opeč na oleji na strednom ohni 8 minút, obracaj ho, kým nie je zo všetkých strán zlatisté a chrumkavé.
steps.en: Pat the tofu dry, cut into 2 cm cubes and fry in the oil over a medium heat for 8 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp on all sides.

steps.sk: Na omáčku zmiešaj v hrnčeku arašidové maslo, kokosové mlieko, sójovú omáčku, cukor, prelisovaný cesnak, nasekané čili, šťavu z limetky a 50 ml vody a za stáleho miešania zohrievaj, kým nie je hladká a hustá.
steps.en: For the sauce mix the peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, sugar, crushed garlic, chopped chilli, lime juice and 50 ml of water in a small pan and heat, stirring, until smooth and thick.

steps.sk: Na taniere poukladaj zemiaky, zeleninu, uhorku nakrájanú na plátky, tofu a vajcia a bohato ich polej teplou omáčkou. Omáčka vydrží v chladničke 5 dní, pred použitím ju zrieď lyžicou teplej vody.
steps.en: Arrange the potatoes, vegetables, sliced cucumber, tofu and eggs on plates and pour plenty of warm sauce over them. The sauce keeps in the fridge for 5 days; loosen it with a spoonful of warm water before using.

description.sk: Indonézske hovädzie pomaly dusené v kokosovom mlieku s korením, kým omáčka úplne nezhustne a nestmavne.
description.en: Indonesian beef slow-cooked in coconut milk and spices until the sauce reduces to a dark, rich coating.

note.sk: kôra a šťava, namiesto citrónovej trávy
note.en: zest and juice, instead of lemongrass

steps.sk: Šalotku, cesnak, zázvor a čili rozmixuj s 3 lyžicami vody na hladkú pastu. Kokos opraž na suchej panvici za stáleho miešania 4 minúty dohneda a odlož ho.
steps.en: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger and chilli with 3 tablespoons of water into a smooth paste. Toast the coconut in a dry pan, stirring constantly, for 4 minutes until brown and set aside.

steps.sk: V hrnci zohrej olej a pastu opekaj na strednom ohni 5 minút, kým nezavonia a voda sa neodparí. Pridaj kurkumu, koriander, škoricu, badián a klinčeky a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pot and fry the paste over a medium heat for 5 minutes until fragrant and the water has evaporated. Add the turmeric, coriander, cinnamon, star anise and cloves and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj hovädzie nakrájané na kocky 4 cm, kokosové mlieko, 200 ml vody, nastrúhanú limetkovú kôru, cukor a soľ. Priveď do varu a var bez pokrievky na miernom ohni 2 hodiny, občas premiešaj.
steps.en: Add the beef cut into 4 cm cubes, the coconut milk, 200 ml of water, the grated lime zest, sugar and salt. Bring to the boil and simmer uncovered over a low heat for 2 hours, stirring now and then.

steps.sk: Keď sa omáčka zredukuje a začne sa z nej oddeľovať olej, vmiešaj opražený kokos a za častého miešania var ešte 15 až 20 minút, kým nie je mäso tmavohnedé, obalené hustou omáčkou a rozpadá sa. Na konci sa ľahko pripáli, preto od hrnca neodchádzaj.
steps.en: Once the sauce has reduced and the oil starts to separate, stir in the toasted coconut and cook, stirring often, for 15 to 20 more minutes until the beef is dark brown, coated in thick sauce and falling apart. It catches easily at the end, so stay by the pot.

steps.sk: Dochuť limetkovou šťavou, vyber škoricu a badián a podávaj s ryžou. Rendang vydrží v chladničke 5 dní a dá sa zamraziť, časom chutí ešte lepšie.
steps.en: Season with the lime juice, remove the cinnamon and star anise and serve with rice. Rendang keeps in the fridge for 5 days and freezes well; it only gets better with time.

title.sk: Jerk kuracie s kokosovou ryžou a fazuľou
title.en: Jerk chicken with rice and peas

description.sk: Jamajské pikantné stehná v marináde z nového korenia, tymianu a čili, s ryžou varenou v kokosovom mlieku.
description.en: Spicy Jamaican thighs marinated in allspice, thyme and chilli, with rice cooked in coconut milk.

steps.sk: Jarnú cibuľku, čili, cesnak, zázvor, nové korenie, tymian, škoricu, cukor, sójovú omáčku, šťavu z jednej limetky a olej rozmixuj na hustú marinádu. Pri práci s pálivým čili si chráň ruky rukavicami.
steps.en: Blend the spring onions, chilli, garlic, ginger, allspice, thyme, cinnamon, sugar, soy sauce, the juice of one lime and the oil into a thick marinade. Wear gloves when handling hot chillies.

steps.sk: Stehná nareži na hrubších miestach, potri ich marinádou a nechaj aspoň 1 hodinu, najlepšie cez noc, marinovať v chladničke.
steps.en: Score the thighs in the thickest parts, rub them with the marinade and leave to marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Stehná ulož na mriežku nad plechom a peč 35 až 40 minút, kým nie sú na okrajoch tmavé až pripečené a šťava pri prepichnutí nie je číra.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Lay the thighs on a rack over a tray and roast for 35 to 40 minutes until dark and charred at the edges and the juices run clear when pierced.

steps.sk: Medzitým prepláchnutú ryžu daj do hrnca so scedenou fazuľou, kokosovým mliekom, 300 ml vody a soľou. Priveď do varu, prikry a var na minimálnom ohni 18 minút, kým ryža nevpije tekutinu.
steps.en: Meanwhile put the rinsed rice in a pot with the drained beans, coconut milk, 300 ml of water and the salt. Bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 18 minutes until the rice has absorbed the liquid.

steps.sk: Ryžu prečechraj vidličkou a podávaj ju so stehnami a mesiačikmi zvyšnej limetky. Stehná vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a výborné sú aj z grilu.
steps.en: Fluff the rice with a fork and serve with the chicken and wedges of the remaining lime. The thighs keep in the fridge for 3 days and are also excellent on a barbecue.

title.sk: Misir wot – etiópsky guláš z červenej šošovice
title.en: Misir wot: Ethiopian red lentil stew

description.sk: Pikantný vegánsky guláš z červenej šošovice s cibuľou a korenistou zmesou podľa berbere.
description.en: A spicy vegan stew of red lentils with onion and a berbere-style spice mix.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj veľmi nadrobno a opekaj ju v hrnci nasucho na miernom ohni 5 minút, kým nezmäkne a nepustí vlhkosť, tak ako sa to robí v Etiópii. Potom pridaj olej a opekaj ďalších 10 minút do zlatohneda.
steps.en: Chop the onions very finely and cook them in a dry pot over a low heat for 5 minutes until soft and their moisture is released, as is done in Ethiopia. Then add the oil and fry for 10 more minutes until golden brown.

steps.sk: Pridaj nastrúhaný zázvor, nasekaný cesnak, paradajkový pretlak a všetky koreniny a za stáleho miešania opekaj 2 minúty, kým zmes nestmavne a nezavonia. Dávaj pozor, aby sa paprika nepripálila.
steps.en: Add the grated ginger, chopped garlic, tomato paste and all the spices and fry, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes until darker and fragrant. Take care not to burn the paprika.

steps.sk: Pridaj prepláchnutú šošovicu, soľ a 900 ml horúcej vody, priveď do varu a var na miernom ohni 25 až 30 minút, často miešaj, kým sa šošovica nerozvarí na hustý guláš.
steps.en: Add the rinsed lentils, the salt and 900 ml of hot water, bring to the boil and simmer gently for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring often, until the lentils break down into a thick stew.

steps.sk: Ak je guláš príliš hustý, prilej vodu, ak je riedky, var ho ešte chvíľu bez pokrievky. Nakoniec ho dochuť citrónovou šťavou.
steps.en: If the stew is too thick, add some water; if it is runny, simmer uncovered a little longer. Finally season with the lemon juice.

steps.sk: Podávaj s teplou pitou namiesto etiópskej placky indžera, ktorou sa guláš naberá rukou. Vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Serve with warm pita in place of Ethiopian injera, which is used to scoop up the stew by hand. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well.

description.sk: Západoafrická ryža varená v hustej omáčke z paradajok, paprík a čili, s kuracími stehnami.
description.en: West African rice cooked in a rich tomato, pepper and chilli sauce, with chicken thighs.

steps.sk: Paradajky, papriky, jednu cibuľu, čili, cesnak a zázvor rozmixuj dohladka. Stehná osoľ polovicou soli a opeč ich na lyžici oleja v širokom hrnci 4 minúty z každej strany dozlatista, potom ich vyber.
steps.en: Blend the tomatoes, peppers, one onion, the chilli, garlic and ginger until smooth. Season the thighs with half the salt and brown them in a spoonful of oil in a wide pot for 4 minutes per side, then lift them out.

steps.sk: Do hrnca pridaj zvyšný olej a druhú cibuľu nakrájanú nadrobno a opekaj 5 minút. Pridaj paradajkový pretlak, kari a tymian a opekaj 2 minúty, kým pretlak nestmavne.
steps.en: Add the remaining oil and the second onion, finely chopped, and fry for 5 minutes. Add the tomato paste, curry powder and thyme and fry for 2 minutes until the paste darkens.

steps.sk: Vlej rozmixovanú zmes a var bez pokrievky na strednom ohni 15 minút, kým sa nezredukuje na hustú omáčku a olej nevystúpi na povrch, to je základ chuti jollof.
steps.en: Pour in the blended mixture and cook uncovered over a medium heat for 15 minutes until reduced to a thick sauce with the oil rising to the surface; this is the base of jollof's flavour.

steps.sk: Pridaj prepláchnutú ryžu, 400 ml horúcej vody s bujónom, bobkové listy, zvyšnú soľ a stehná. Priveď do varu, prikry tesne alobalom a pokrievkou a var na minimálnom ohni 25 minút, kým nie je ryža mäkká. Nemiešaj, len raz po 15 minútach ryžu opatrne prevráť zospodu.
steps.en: Add the rinsed rice, 400 ml of hot water with the stock cube, the bay leaves, the remaining salt and the chicken. Bring to the boil, cover tightly with foil and a lid and cook on the lowest heat for 25 minutes until the rice is tender. Do not stir; just turn the rice over gently from the bottom once after 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Nechaj 5 minút postáť pod pokrievkou a podávaj. Mierne pripečená vrstva na dne sa považuje za pochúťku. Vydrží v chladničke 3 dni, prehrievaj ju s lyžicou vody.
steps.en: Leave to stand, covered, for 5 minutes and serve. The slightly toasted layer on the bottom is considered a treat. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days; reheat with a spoonful of water.

title.sk: Maafe – arašidový guláš s kuracím a batátmi
title.en: Maafe: peanut stew with chicken and sweet potato

description.sk: Senegalský krémový guláš z kuracieho mäsa, batátov a mrkvy v paradajkovo-arašidovej omáčke.
description.en: A creamy Senegalese stew of chicken, sweet potato and carrot in a tomato and peanut sauce.

steps.sk: Kuracie mäso nakrájaj na kúsky 4 cm a opeč ho na oleji v hrnci na vysokom ohni 5 minút dozlatista. Pridaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a opekaj 5 minút, potom pridaj cesnak, zázvor, čili a pretlak a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into 4 cm pieces and brown in the oil in a pot over a high heat for 5 minutes. Add the finely chopped onion and fry for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, chilli and tomato paste and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Vlej paradajky a 600 ml horúcej vody s bujónom. Arašidové maslo rozmiešaj v naberačke horúcej tekutiny dohladka a až potom ho vmiešaj do hrnca, aby nevznikli hrudky.
steps.en: Pour in the tomatoes and 600 ml of hot water with the stock cube. Stir the peanut butter into a ladleful of the hot liquid until smooth and only then stir it into the pot so no lumps form.

steps.sk: Pridaj batát nakrájaný na kocky 3 cm a mrkvu na kolieska, priveď do varu a var pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 30 minút. Občas premiešaj, arašidová omáčka sa rada prichytáva na dno.
steps.en: Add the sweet potato cut into 3 cm cubes and the carrots in rounds, bring to the boil and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 30 minutes. Stir now and then, as peanut sauce likes to catch on the bottom.

steps.sk: Keď je batát mäkký a omáčka hustá a krémová, ochutnaj ju; ak je priveľmi hustá, prilej trochu vody. Medzitým uvar ryžu podľa návodu na obale.
steps.en: When the sweet potato is tender and the sauce thick and creamy, taste it; if it is too thick, add a little water. Meanwhile cook the rice according to the packet.

steps.sk: Podávaj na ryži posypané nasekaným koriandrom. Maafe vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Serve over the rice, sprinkled with chopped coriander. Maafe keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well.

title.sk: Bobotie – juhoafrická mäsová zapekanka s kari
title.en: Bobotie: South African curried mince bake

description.sk: Mleté hovädzie s kari, hrozienkami a džemom, zapečené pod jemnou vaječnou zálievkou.
description.en: Curried minced beef with raisins and jam, baked under a soft egg custard.

note.sk: 100 ml na chlieb, 200 ml do zálievky
note.en: 100 ml for the bread, 200 ml for the custard
1 for the meat, 2 for the custard

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Chlieb natrhaj a namoč v 100 ml mlieka. Na masle opekaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 8 minút do mäkka, pridaj cesnak, kari a kurkumu a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Tear the bread and soak it in 100 ml of milk. Fry the finely chopped onions in the butter for 8 minutes until soft, then add the garlic, curry powder and turmeric and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso a opekaj 6 minút, kým sa nerozdrobí a nestratí ružovú farbu. Stiahni z ohňa a vmiešaj vytlačený chlieb, hrozienka, džem, citrónovú šťavu, soľ a jedno vajce.
steps.en: Add the beef and fry for 6 minutes until crumbly and no longer pink. Take off the heat and mix in the squeezed bread, the raisins, jam, lemon juice, salt and one egg.

steps.sk: Zmes natlač do zapekacej misy a do povrchu zapichni bobkové listy. Zvyšné vajcia rozšľahaj s 200 ml mlieka, opatrne prelej mäso a posyp mandľami.
steps.en: Press the mixture into a baking dish and push the bay leaves into the surface. Whisk the remaining eggs with 200 ml of milk, pour carefully over the meat and scatter with the almonds.

steps.sk: Peč 35 až 40 minút, kým vaječná zálievka nestuhne a nie je navrchu zlatistá. Medzitým uvar ryžu; ak chceš, zafarbi ju štipkou kurkumy.
steps.en: Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until the custard has set and is golden on top. Meanwhile cook the rice; you can colour it with a pinch of turmeric.

steps.sk: Nechaj 5 minút postáť, vyber bobkové listy a nakrájaj na porcie. Bobotie vydrží v chladničke 3 dni, porcie zohrievaj v rúre.
steps.en: Leave to stand for 5 minutes, remove the bay leaves and cut into portions. Bobotie keeps in the fridge for 3 days; reheat portions in the oven.

title.sk: Lobio – gruzínska fazuľa s orechmi a koriandrom
title.en: Lobio: Georgian beans with walnuts and coriander

description.sk: Hustý vegánsky fazuľový guláš s opraženými orechmi, cesnakom, koriandrom a octom.
description.en: A thick vegan bean stew with toasted walnuts, garlic, coriander and vinegar.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a opekaj ju na oleji v hrnci na strednom ohni 10 minút, kým nie je mäkká a zlatistá.
steps.en: Finely chop the onions and fry them in the oil in a pot over a medium heat for 10 minutes until soft and golden.

steps.sk: Pridaj scedenú fazuľu, mletý koriander, papriku, čili a 250 ml vody a var na miernom ohni 15 minút. Asi polovicu fazule roztlač varechou, aby vznikla hustá krémová zmes.
steps.en: Add the drained beans, ground coriander, paprika, chilli and 250 ml of water and simmer gently for 15 minutes. Crush about half the beans with a wooden spoon to make a thick, creamy mixture.

steps.sk: Orechy opraž na suchej panvici 3 minúty, kým nezavoňajú, a s cesnakom a soľou ich rozdrv v mažiari alebo nasekaj nožom najemno na hrubú pastu.
steps.en: Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes until fragrant, then pound them with the garlic and salt in a mortar or chop finely with a knife into a coarse paste.

steps.sk: Orechovú pastu, ocot a nasekaný koriander vmiešaj do fazule a prehrej ešte 2 minúty. Lobio má byť husté a výrazné, s jemne kyslastým tónom.
steps.en: Stir the walnut paste, vinegar and chopped coriander into the beans and heat for 2 more minutes. Lobio should be thick and bold with a gentle sourness.

steps.sk: Podávaj teplé alebo izbovej teploty s chlebom a nakladanou zeleninou. Vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a na druhý deň je ešte chutnejšie.
steps.en: Serve warm or at room temperature with bread and pickled vegetables. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days and is even tastier the next day.

title.sk: Švédske mäsové guľky v smotanovej omáčke

description.sk: Jemné guľky z hovädzieho a bravčového v smotanovej omáčke, so zemiakmi a brusnicovým džemom.
description.en: Tender beef and pork meatballs in a creamy sauce with potatoes and lingonberry jam.

steps.sk: Strúhanku zalej mliekom a nechaj 5 minút napučať. Cibuľu nastrúhaj najjemnejšie a pridaj ju k mäsu spolu so strúhankou, vajcom, novým korením, muškátovým orieškom a soľou. Dôkladne premiešaj a vytvaruj asi 30 guliek veľkosti vlašského orecha.
steps.en: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 minutes. Grate the onion very finely and add it to the meat with the breadcrumbs, egg, allspice, nutmeg and salt. Mix thoroughly and shape about 30 walnut-sized balls.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a uvar vo vode 20 minút do mäkka. Medzitým na panvici rozpusti polovicu masla a guľky opekaj po dávkach na strednom ohni 8 minút, kým nie sú dookola opečené a v strede prepečené. Vyber ich.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and boil for 20 minutes until tender. Meanwhile melt half the butter in a frying pan and fry the meatballs in batches over a medium heat for 8 minutes until browned all over and cooked through. Lift them out.

steps.sk: Na výpekoch rozpusti zvyšné maslo, vmiešaj múku a minútu ju opekaj. Za stáleho miešania prilej 400 ml horúcej vody s bujónom, smotanu a sójovú omáčku a var 4 minúty, kým omáčka nezhustne.
steps.en: Melt the remaining butter in the pan juices, stir in the flour and cook for a minute. Stirring constantly, pour in 400 ml of hot water with the stock cube, the cream and the soy sauce and simmer for 4 minutes until thickened.

steps.sk: Guľky vráť do omáčky a na miernom ohni ich prehrievaj 3 minúty, aby nasali chuť. Ak je omáčka príliš hustá, zrieď ju lyžicou vody.
steps.en: Return the meatballs to the sauce and warm them over a low heat for 3 minutes so they take on the flavour. If the sauce is too thick, loosen it with a spoonful of water.

steps.sk: Podávaj so zemiakmi posypanými petržlenovou vňaťou a lyžicou džemu, ktorého sladkokyslá chuť k jedlu patrí. Guľky v omáčke vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a dajú sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Serve with the potatoes sprinkled with parsley and a spoonful of jam, whose sweet-sour taste belongs with the dish. The meatballs in sauce keep in the fridge for 3 days and freeze well.

title.sk: Poke miska s krevetami a mangom

description.sk: Havajská miska s ochutenou sushi ryžou, marinovanými krevetami, mangom, avokádom a edamame.
description.en: A Hawaiian bowl of seasoned sushi rice with marinated prawns, mango, avocado and edamame.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni v studenej vode, kým voda nie je číra, a uvar ju podľa návodu. Ocot, cukor a soľ zohrej, kým sa nerozpustia, vmiešaj ich do teplej ryže a nechaj ju vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu.
steps.en: Rinse the rice in cold water until it runs clear and cook according to the packet. Warm the vinegar, sugar and salt until dissolved, stir into the warm rice and leave it to cool to room temperature.

steps.sk: Krevety var vo vriacej vode 2 až 3 minúty, kým nie sú ružové a stočené, sceď a ochlaď ich. Premiešaj ich so sójovou omáčkou, sezamovým olejom a nastrúhaným zázvorom a nechaj 10 minút marinovať.
steps.en: Cook the prawns in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes until pink and curled, then drain and cool. Toss with the soy sauce, sesame oil and grated ginger and leave to marinate for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Edamame var 4 minúty a sceď. Mango, avokádo a uhorku nakrájaj na kocky, mrkvu na tenké prúžky, jarnú cibuľku nadrobno a nori na tenké pásiky. Majonézu zmiešaj s čili omáčkou na pikantný dresing.
steps.en: Boil the edamame for 4 minutes and drain. Dice the mango, avocado and cucumber, cut the carrot into thin strips, finely chop the spring onions and slice the nori into thin strips. Mix the mayonnaise with the chilli sauce for a spicy dressing.

steps.sk: Do misiek daj ryžu, navrch poukladaj krevety s marinádou, zeleninu, mango a edamame, polej dresingom a posyp sezamom, jarnou cibuľkou a nori. Podávaj hneď; ryža a krevety vydržia oddelene v chladničke 1 deň.
steps.en: Put the rice in bowls, arrange the prawns with their marinade, the vegetables, mango and edamame on top, drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle with sesame, spring onion and nori. Serve straight away; the rice and prawns keep separately in the fridge for 1 day.

title.sk: Anzac sušienky s ovsenými vločkami a kokosom

description.sk: Austrálske maslové sušienky z vločiek, kokosu a medu, žuvacie alebo chrumkavé podľa času pečenia.
description.en: Australian butter biscuits of oats, coconut and honey, chewy or crisp depending on baking time.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 170 °C a dva plechy vystel papierom na pečenie. V mise zmiešaj vločky, múku, kokos, hnedý cukor a soľ.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 170 °C and line two trays with baking paper. In a bowl mix the oats, flour, coconut, brown sugar and salt.

steps.sk: V hrnčeku rozpusti maslo s medom. Sódu bikarbónu rozmiešaj v 2 lyžiciach horúcej vody a vlej ju k maslu, zmes spení. Hneď ju vlej do suchých surovín a premiešaj na vlhké cesto.
steps.en: Melt the butter with the honey in a small pan. Dissolve the bicarbonate of soda in 2 tablespoons of hot water and pour it into the butter; it will foam. Pour it straight into the dry ingredients and mix to a moist dough.

steps.sk: Z cesta tvaruj guľky veľkosti vlašského orecha a klaď ich na plechy s rozostupmi 5 cm, pri pečení sa roztečú. Každú zľahka splošti dlaňou.
steps.en: Roll the dough into walnut-sized balls and set them on the trays 5 cm apart, as they spread while baking. Flatten each one slightly with your palm.

steps.sk: Peč 12 až 14 minút, kým nie sú zlatohnedé. Po vybratí sú ešte mäkké a na plechu za 10 minút stvrdnú; kratšie pečené zostanú vo vnútri žuvacie, dlhšie pečené budú chrumkavé.
steps.en: Bake for 12 to 14 minutes until golden brown. They are still soft when they come out and firm up on the tray within 10 minutes; shorter baking keeps them chewy inside, longer makes them crisp.

steps.sk: Nechaj ich úplne vychladnúť na mriežke a ulož do uzavretej dózy, kde vydržia aj 2 týždne. Pôvodne sa piekli ako trvanlivé sušienky, ktoré prežili dlhú cestu.
steps.en: Let them cool completely on a rack and store in an airtight tin, where they keep for up to 2 weeks. They were originally baked as long-lasting biscuits that survived a long journey.

title.sk: Mee goreng – restované rezance po indonézsky

description.sk: Vaječné rezance restované s kuracím, vajcom, pak choi a sladko-pikantnou omáčkou.
description.en: Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, egg, pak choi and a sweet and spicy sauce.

note.en: with the soy sauce, instead of kecap manis

steps.sk: Rezance uvar podľa návodu, sceď, prepláchni studenou vodou a premiešaj s lyžicou oleja, aby sa nezlepili. Sójovú omáčku, cukor, kečup a čili omáčku zmiešaj v miske na omáčku.
steps.en: Cook the noodles according to the packet, drain, rinse under cold water and toss with a spoonful of oil so they do not stick. Mix the soy sauce, sugar, ketchup and chilli sauce in a bowl for the sauce.

steps.sk: Kuracie mäso nakrájaj na tenké prúžky. Vo woku rozohrej lyžicu oleja a mäso opekaj na vysokom ohni 4 minúty, kým nie je zlatisté a prepečené. Pridaj nasekaný cesnak a biele časti jarnej cibuľky a opekaj 30 sekúnd.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into thin strips. Heat a spoonful of oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken over a high heat for 4 minutes until golden and cooked through. Add the chopped garlic and the white parts of the spring onions and fry for 30 seconds.

steps.sk: Pridaj pak choi nakrájaný na kúsky a paradajku na mesiačiky a opekaj 2 minúty. Zeleninu posuň na okraj, do stredu vlej zvyšný olej a rozšľahané vajcia a miešaj, kým nie sú napoly stuhnuté.
steps.en: Add the pak choi cut into pieces and the tomato in wedges and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Push the vegetables to the side, pour the remaining oil and the beaten eggs into the middle and stir until half set.

steps.sk: Pridaj rezance a omáčku a všetko premiešavaj na vysokom ohni 2 až 3 minúty, kým rezance nie sú horúce, rovnomerne zafarbené a miestami mierne opečené. Nakoniec vmiešaj klíčky.
steps.en: Add the noodles and sauce and toss everything over a high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until the noodles are hot, evenly coloured and lightly charred in places. Finally stir in the bean sprouts.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypané zelenými časťami jarnej cibuľky s mesiačikmi limetky. Zvyšky vydržia v chladničke 2 dni, prehrej ich na panvici.
steps.en: Serve sprinkled with the green parts of the spring onions, with lime wedges. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days; reheat them in a pan.

description.sk: Mäkké kysnuté uzlíky s kardamónom, plnené maslom so škoricou.
description.en: Soft yeasted buns flavoured with cardamom and filled with cinnamon butter.

note.sk: 75 g do cesta, 50 g do plnky
note.en: 75 g for the dough, 50 g for the filling

note.sk: 60 g do cesta, 50 g do plnky
note.en: 60 g for the dough, 50 g for the filling

steps.sk: Mlieko zohrej, kým nie je vlažné, a rozpusti v ňom 75 g masla. V mise zmiešaj múku, 60 g cukru, droždie, kardamón a soľ, vlej mlieko s maslom a mies 8 až 10 minút na hladké a pružné cesto.
steps.en: Warm the milk until lukewarm and melt 75 g of butter in it. In a bowl mix the flour, 60 g of sugar, the yeast, cardamom and salt, pour in the milk and butter and knead for 8 to 10 minutes into a smooth, elastic dough.

steps.sk: Misu prikry utierkou a nechaj cesto kysnúť na teplom mieste 1 hodinu, kým nezdvojnásobí objem.
steps.en: Cover the bowl with a cloth and leave the dough to rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.

steps.sk: Na plnku vymiešaj 50 g mäkkého masla so zvyšným cukrom a škoricou. Cesto rozvaľkaj na obdĺžnik 30 × 40 cm, natri ho plnkou a pozdĺžne stoč do pevnej rolády.
steps.en: For the filling beat 50 g of soft butter with the remaining sugar and the cinnamon. Roll the dough into a 30 × 40 cm rectangle, spread with the filling and roll up tightly lengthways.

steps.sk: Roládu nakrájaj na 12 kúskov a poukladaj ich reznou stranou nahor na plech s papierom na pečenie alebo do papierových košíčkov. Nechaj ich ešte 30 minút kysnúť a medzitým rúru predhrej na 220 °C.
steps.en: Cut the roll into 12 pieces and set them cut side up on a lined tray or in paper cases. Leave them to rise for another 30 minutes while the oven heats to 220 °C.

steps.sk: Potri ich rozšľahaným vajcom a peč 10 až 12 minút, kým nie sú zlatohnedé. Najlepšie sú vlažné v deň pečenia; vychladnuté sa dajú zamraziť a rozmraziť krátko v rúre.
steps.en: Brush with beaten egg and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown. They are best warm on the day of baking; once cool they freeze well and can be refreshed briefly in the oven.

title.sk: Lohikeitto – fínska lososová polievka s kôprom
title.en: Lohikeitto: Finnish salmon soup with dill

description.sk: Jemná smotanová polievka so zemiakmi, pórom, mrkvou, kúskami lososa a množstvom kôpru.
description.en: A gentle creamy soup with potatoes, leek, carrot, chunks of salmon and plenty of dill.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozpusti maslo a pór nakrájaný na kolieska opekaj na miernom ohni 5 minút, kým nezmäkne. Pridaj mrkvu na kolieska a zemiaky nakrájané na kocky 2 cm.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a pot and gently fry the leek, sliced into rounds, for 5 minutes until soft. Add the carrots in rounds and the potatoes cut into 2 cm cubes.

steps.sk: Zalej 1 litrom horúcej vody s bujónom, pridaj nové korenie, bobkový list a soľ a var 15 minút, kým nie sú zemiaky mäkké.
steps.en: Pour in 1 litre of hot water with the stock cube, add the allspice, bay leaf and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.

steps.sk: Lososa zbav kože a prípadných kostí a nakrájaj ho na kocky 3 cm. Do polievky vlej smotanu, priveď ju takmer k varu a vlož lososa.
steps.en: Skin the salmon, remove any bones and cut it into 3 cm cubes. Pour the cream into the soup, bring it almost to the boil and add the salmon.

steps.sk: Stiahni oheň na minimum a nechaj lososa jemne dôjsť 4 až 5 minút, kým nie je v strede nepriehľadný a ľahko sa rozpadá. Polievku už prudko nemiešaj, kocky by sa rozpadli.
steps.en: Turn the heat right down and let the salmon poach gently for 4 to 5 minutes until opaque in the centre and flaking easily. Do not stir vigorously or the chunks break up.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj veľa nasekaného kôpru a podávaj s ražným chlebom. Polievka vydrží v chladničke 2 dni, prehrievaj ju pomaly a nevar.
steps.en: Stir in plenty of chopped dill and serve with rye bread. The soup keeps in the fridge for 2 days; reheat it gently without boiling.

title.sk: Poutine – pečené hranolky so syrom a hnedou omáčkou
title.en: Oven poutine: fries with cheese and gravy

description.sk: Kanadská klasika v ľahšej verzii: hranolky z rúry s mozzarellou, prelievané horúcou hnedou omáčkou.
description.en: A lighter take on the Canadian classic: oven fries with mozzarella and hot brown gravy.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Zemiaky nakrájaj na hranolky hrubé 1 cm, namoč ich na 15 minút do studenej vody, aby pustili škrob, a potom ich dôkladne osuš utierkou.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the potatoes into 1 cm thick fries, soak them in cold water for 15 minutes to release the starch, then dry them thoroughly with a cloth.

steps.sk: Hranolky premiešaj s olejom a soľou, rozlož ich na dva plechy s papierom v jednej vrstve a peč 30 až 35 minút, v polovici ich obráť, kým nie sú zlatisté a chrumkavé.
steps.en: Toss the fries with the oil and salt, spread them in a single layer on two lined trays and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

steps.sk: Medzitým priprav hnedú omáčku: v hrnčeku rozpusti maslo, vmiešaj múku a za stáleho miešania ju opekaj 3 minúty, kým nezhnedne do farby lieskového orieška.
steps.en: Meanwhile make the gravy: melt the butter in a small pan, stir in the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 3 minutes until hazelnut brown.

steps.sk: Za stáleho miešania prilej 400 ml horúcej vody s bujónom, sójovú omáčku, cesnakový prášok a korenie a var 5 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne a nie je lesklá.
steps.en: Stirring constantly, pour in 400 ml of hot water with the stock cube, the soy sauce, garlic powder and pepper and simmer for 5 minutes until thick and glossy.

steps.sk: Horúce hranolky daj do misiek, posyp ich natrhanou mozzarellou a hneď prelej horúcou omáčkou, aby syr začal mäknúť. Jedz ihneď, kým hranolky chrumkajú.
steps.en: Put the hot fries in bowls, scatter with the torn mozzarella and pour over the hot gravy straight away so the cheese starts to melt. Eat at once while the fries are crisp.

title.sk: Chakalaka s fazuľou a kukuričnou kašou
title.en: Chakalaka with beans and maize porridge

description.sk: Juhoafrická pikantná zeleninová zmes s fazuľou a kari, podávaná na hustej kukuričnej kaši, vegánska.
description.en: A spicy South African vegetable and bean relish with curry, served over thick maize porridge, vegan.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno, papriky na drobné kocky a mrkvu nastrúhaj nahrubo. V hrnci zohrej olej a cibuľu s paprikami opekaj na strednom ohni 6 minút, kým nezmäknú.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion, dice the peppers small and coarsely grate the carrots. Heat the oil in a pot and fry the onion and peppers over a medium heat for 6 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Pridaj nasekaný cesnak, nastrúhaný zázvor, nasekané čili, kari a údenú papriku a minútu opekaj. Potom pridaj mrkvu a opekaj ďalšie 3 minúty.
steps.en: Add the chopped garlic, grated ginger, chopped chilli, curry powder and smoked paprika and fry for a minute. Then add the carrots and fry for 3 more minutes.

steps.sk: Vlej paradajky, pridaj scedenú fazuľu a polovicu soli a var bez pokrievky na miernom ohni 15 minút, kým zelenina nezmäkne a omáčka nezhustne. Chakalaka má byť hustá a pikantná.
steps.en: Pour in the tomatoes, add the drained beans and half the salt and simmer uncovered over a low heat for 15 minutes until the vegetables are soft and the sauce has thickened. Chakalaka should be thick and spicy.

steps.sk: Medzitým priveď do varu 900 ml vody so zvyšnou soľou, za stáleho miešania metličkou do nej pomaly vsyp polentu a var na miernom ohni podľa obalu, kým nie je hustá a hladká. Často miešaj, kaša sa rada pripaľuje.
steps.en: Meanwhile bring 900 ml of water to the boil with the remaining salt, slowly whisk in the polenta and cook over a low heat according to the packet until thick and smooth. Stir often, as it catches easily.

steps.sk: Podávaj kašu s horúcou chakalakou navrchu. Chakalaka vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a je výborná aj studená ako príloha ku grilovanému mäsu.
steps.en: Serve the porridge topped with the hot chakalaka. Chakalaka keeps in the fridge for 4 days and is also great cold as a side to grilled meat.
